title: Accounts Receivable
description:
Cashier Administrator

Location: Peterborough
Salary: Up to £27,000 per annum
Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (hybrid after 3/6 months)

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Cashier Administrator to join our busy finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous finance or cashiering experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in maintaining accuracy.

You will play a key role in ensuring financial transactions are processed efficiently, reconciliations are completed accurately, and finance records are maintained to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities
- Posting and allocating daily cash sheets and banking transactions.
- Processing journals where required.
- Handling finance-related queries and resolving issues promptly.
- Completing full bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Auditing cashbook supporting documentation to ensure completeness and authorisation.
- Maintaining accurate filing and record-keeping systems.
- Posting cash-paid transactions, including cheque payments and cleared banking entries.
- Supporting the wider finance team with administrative duties as required.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience within a finance, accounts, cashiering or administrative role.
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- The ability to manage a high volume of transactions efficiently.
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Experience using accounting or finance systems would be advantageous but is not essential.

Benefits
- Competitive salary up to £27,000 depending on experience.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Contributory pension scheme.
- Life assurance.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Career progression within a growing organisation.
- Employee discounts and benefits platform.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.

title: Enterprise Sales Administrator
description:
Enterprise Sales Administrator - Telecoms

Location: Peterborough

Package: £30,000 plus 10% bonus, private healthcare.

We re recruiting an Enterprise Sales Administrator to join a business connectivity and fibre network provider, supporting its Enterprise sales operation.

This is a great opportunity for an organised, commercially minded administrator who enjoys working in a busy sales environment. You ll sit at the heart of the Enterprise team, helping ensure customer enquiries, sales orders and onboarding activity move smoothly from initial opportunity through to delivery.

Ideally, you need to be from a telecoms background, but we'll try to keep an open mind across various technology sectors that operate on a B2 B basis.

What will you be doing?

You ll provide day-to-day administrative support to the Enterprise sales team, including:
- Processing sales orders and ensuring information is accurate across CRM, customer documentation and internal systems
- Maintaining customer, partner and opportunity records
- Preparing quotes, order forms, sales documentation and supporting materials
- Supporting new customer and partner onboarding
- Tracking orders, sales activity and outstanding actions through to completion
- Liaising with Sales, Operations, Finance and Service Delivery teams
- Helping ensure a smooth handover from sale through to service delivery and billing
- Maintaining sales trackers, reports and pipeline information
- Supporting meetings, action logs and follow-up activity
- Responding professionally to internal stakeholders, partners and customers

The role has plenty of interaction across the business, so it will suit someone who likes taking ownership and chasing things through rather than simply waiting for the next task to land.

What are we looking for?

You ll ideally have experience in sales administration, customer administration, order processing, sales support or a similar coordination role.

More importantly, you ll be someone who is highly organised, accurate and comfortable juggling multiple priorities. You ll need good communication skills, confidence dealing with different departments and the ability to follow up actions without needing constant prompting.

Experience using CRM or sales systems and good working knowledge of Excel, Outlook, Word and Teams will be important. Previous experience within telecoms, connectivity, wholesale, channel sales or a B2 B technology environment would be highly advantageous.

Peterborough based, and you'll be in the office 5 days each week (Monday to Friday) so this isn't a remote role.

Job Description Medical Receptionist / Administrator The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will be responsible for providing a professional, efficient and welcoming service to patients, visitors and colleagues. The post holder will support the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and work closely with both clinical and non-clinical members of the team. The duties and responsibilities of the role will include: Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally, dealing with patient enquiries appropriately and transferring calls when required. Process face-to-face, telephone and online/electronic requests from patients. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system, booking, cancelling and amending appointments as appropriate. Signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional, service or source of support. Respond to enquiries and requests from patients, colleagues and external organisations in a professional and timely manner. Provide a welcoming and helpful reception service to patients and visitors attending the practice. Accurately update and maintain patient healthcare records using SystmOne. Read code information onto patient records where appropriate. Process new patient and temporary patient registrations and ensure relevant information is recorded accurately. Undertake general data entry and administrative duties as required. Process incoming correspondence and direct requests such as Subject Access Requests (SARs), insurance reports, solicitor requests and DVLA forms to the appropriate administrative team. Photocopy, scan and process documentation as required. Manage general patient and practice queries efficiently and appropriately. Support clinical and non-clinical colleagues with general administrative tasks as required. Maintain a clean, tidy and effective reception and working environment. Monitor and maintain the reception area and patient notice boards. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with information governance and data protection requirements at all times. Follow practice policies, procedures and protocols and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment. Work collaboratively as part of the wider practice team and provide support and cover to colleagues when required. Attend practice meetings and undertake relevant training as required. Provide cover at other practice sites when required due to operational needs, staff absence or sickness. The post holder will be expected to demonstrate flexibility and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role as required by the Practice Manager or Partners. This job description is intended as a guide to the main responsibilities of the post and may be reviewed and amended from time to time to reflect the changing needs of the practice.
